title: PromptDecision
description: Server-side decision compiled before any provider call — the source the SSE 'decision' event (Docs/contracts/schemas/sse-events.schema.json) is populated from. Closed enums only; never influenced by untrusted content (V2-ARCHITECTURE.md §12.1, §12.3's typed PromptPlan). Phase 5 sets these deterministically from the explicit requestedAction; Phase 6 (Stage 6.3's classifier_fast) is the first caller that derives them from ambiguous signals.

promptVersion.description: Matches a promptVersion value in manifest.yaml, e.g. 'grammar@5.1.0'.

confidence.description: Always null for mode = explicit (Phase 5). Measured value for mode = auto (Phase 6).
